Name: C. S. Lewis
Summary: Oxford scholar and former atheist whose conversion, chronicled in Surprised by Joy, made him the twentieth century's most beloved Christian writer. Through Narnia and plain-spoken apologetics he led millions to faith.
Contribution: Defended the faith with reason and imagination, making Christianity credible and beautiful to ordinary readers.
KeyWorks: Mere Christianity; The Chronicles of Narnia; Surprised by Joy
Testimony: His testimony was joy itself: a longing nothing in this world satisfied, finally answered by the God who made him for Himself.
